services.desc: For booking inquiries, please reach out via email at dd2pac@dorchester2.k12.sc.us.​​ Thank you for hosting your event at the Summers Corner Performing Arts Center. For your convenience, the performing arts center offers an online payment option for all of our clients through Harris School Solutions facilitated by Dorchester School District Two. To access the payment portal, click on the link below. The next page will show a list of schools. Select “Performing Arts Center”. As you can see, the payment system is set up with parents and students in mind. Please fill out all of your contact information including your address, email and phone number.
